# pytest fixtures

Fixtures for spec 007 (pytest runner). `test/runners/pytest/fixtures.test.ts` copies `small/` to a temp directory, syncs it with uv on Python 3.10 and 3.13 (`test/helpers/pytest-env.ts`) and runs it with plain `python -m pytest`, checking it behaves as described here. Never sync or run them in place: the tree holds no `.venv`, `__pycache__` or `.pytest_cache`, and the test fails when one appears.

| Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `small/` | The 007-02 research's small project: `pyproject.toml` with `[tool.pytest.ini_options]` (`testpaths = ["tests"]`), `src/app` (hatchling, editable through a path `.pth`), the uv workspace member `packages/other` (setuptools, editable, with the namespace package `acme.ns` and a `pytest11` entry-point plugin), `tests/` with a root `conftest.py` naming `pytest_plugins`, a nested `tests/unit/conftest.py`, a parametrized test, `mocker`, package data through `importlib.resources` and a test data file read by relative path, and the `app-cli` console script (`app.cli:main`, also run by `python -m app` through `src/app/__main__.py`), which no test imports (task 007-55). `uv.lock` is committed; sync with `--locked`. |
| `small/src/app/core.py` | The edge-case file: every import form of 007 D4 (`import a.b`, relative, `from a import b` as submodule and as name, both arms of `try/except ImportError`, function-local, `import_module` and `__import__` with literals, `TYPE_CHECKING`, a computed `import_module` on line 35). `src/app/edge/cases.py` stresses parsers. |
| `small/outcomes/` | Outcome files, outside `testpaths` so the project's own suite stays green; run by naming them. `test_pass.py`; `test_fail.py` (one pass, one assertion failure); `test_collection_error.py` (imports the absent `app.not_there`); `test_phases.py` (setup error, teardown error after a passing call, skip, xfail, xpass, strict xpass); `test_hang.py` (spawns a sleeping child, writes its PID to `$FIXTURE_HANG_PID_FILE` when set, then sleeps 600 s); `test_spawn_module.py` and `test_spawn_script.py` (run `python -m app` and `app-cli` in a child process, task 007-55); `test_spawn_tool.py` (runs `python tool.py`, whose `tool.py` beside it only prints, review 0.1.268 B2); `test_site_marker.py` (passes only when the environment's own `sitecustomize` sets `builtins.FIXTURE_SITECUSTOMIZE`, in pytest and in a child; `test/runners/pytest/spawned.test.ts` installs one). No `__init__.py`: each file's basedir is `outcomes/` under the default `prepend` import mode. |
| `gen-big.py` | Cost fixture: `python gen-big.py [outDir]` writes 1,000 modules (960 in `src/big`, 40 in the workspace member `packages/libb`) and 200 test files in 10 directories each with a `conftest.py`, every import form, deterministic for a seed, in well under a second. Default output `big/`, git-ignored. Has no `uv.lock`. |
| `ast_graph.py` | Graph oracle: `<venv>/bin/python -I ast_graph.py <root> <out.json> [--skip-type-checking]` resolves every `.py` under `<root>` through the interpreter's own finders without executing project code, with pytest's prepend basedirs, and writes each file's edges, unresolved imports, computed-import lines and resolution candidates. |
